scope: Deterministic three-dimensional WorkItem state projection backed by persisted Run history

implementation.legacyRunWithoutAttention: decodes with an empty attention set

verifiedInvariants: Input run order does not affect the projection.
Runs belonging to another WorkItem do not affect the projection.
A retry after failure becomes running and increments the reactivation generation.
A prior failure remains attention while replacement work is active.
A successful retry leaves the failed Run in history and clears current failure attention.
Needs-input and running facts can coexist without fabricating a terminal outcome.
Stale remains an attention fact and does not become failed or completed.
The projection remains the same after TaskRunStore restart.

verification.macOSBuild: Anchor macOS arm64 Debug build succeeded with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
verification.faultInjectionSoak: 8 turns passed with process restarts, atomic replacement and in-place truncation

limitations: Task-level aggregate projection is not implemented.
The production Mac and iPhone UI do not consume this projection yet.
Real Codex needs-input and failure lifecycle evidence is not available through the current three-record JSONL adapter.
The new persistence fields and projection are uncommitted local work.
